- scripts/gh_helpers.sh
  Line or code reference: _parse_reset_header, lines 144-145
  Problem: The Retry-After extractor uses `awk '{print $2}'`, which only parses the value when there is whitespace after the colon. An RFC-compliant header written as `Retry-After:45` (no space) is treated as a single awk field, so `$2` is empty and the function falls through to the X-RateLimit-Reset path. That reintroduces the very failure mode this PR fixes: a secondary-limit 403 would sleep up to the 600 s cap instead of the requested wait.
  Why it fails at runtime: If GitHub (or an intermediate proxy) ever emits `Retry-After` without a space after the colon, `curl_gh_api` ignores the authoritative secondary-limit wait and computes the sleep from the primary-window reset, which can be up to an hour away.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
